messages:
anya: Received the pen-test deck from VectorSec. Summary: excessive service-account bindings (lateral RBAC risk), KMS audit exporter disabled on one key vault, and gaps in inter-service auth logs. We need a short remediation window + sealed evidence for retest. Who can take RBAC, who will pull key/audit slices, and who will package artifacts?

derek: I can take RBAC. I'll do a least-privilege carve: create a new limited custom role, run a canary attach against `svc-plat-canary`, and monitor. ETA to post plan: today EOD.

rachel: I'll own key/audit extraction. We have three clouds to collect from (GCP, AWS, Azure). I'll pull Cloud Audit logs, CloudTrail, and Azure Diagnostic logs for Key Vault. Will not rotate or rewrap keys before capture.

anya: Good. Target window: Thu 2024-10-03 15:30 UTC -> 75m. Sequence: pre-snapshots -> RBAC canary -> wait 20m -> full roll if stable -> collect artifact sets -> seal + sign -> upload + presigned links -> vendor retest.

tom: I'll package artifacts and manage the evidence bucket. Plan to use `gs://redwood-pt-sentinel-4455` with uniform access, object versioning, and retention lock for 45d. I'll enable server-side encryption and force uploads to be signed. For signatures we'll use detached GPG plus a cosign timestamp for the bundle.

ops-oncall: Standby for the window. If control-plane issues arise, page SRE immediately. Have rollback ready: reapply pre-iam snapshot or restore terraform state.

derek: RBAC canary plan (brief): 1) export pre-state `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json` and `az role assignment list --all > pre-iam-az.$TS.json` 2) create `infra.restrict` custom role 3) attach to `svc-plat-canary` 4) monitor application logs + auth-denied rates for 20m 5) rollout or rollback. I'll include a `tf plan -out=rbac-plan` in PR.

rachel: Key and audit export commands (examples):
GCP: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" OR protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy"' --freshness=60d --format=json > kms-gcp-60d.ndjson`
AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-01 --end-time 2024-10-03 --query Events > kms-aws-60d.json`
Azure: `az monitor activity-log list --start-time 2024-08-01 --end-time 2024-10-03 --query "[?contains(resourceProvider,'Microsoft.KeyVault')]" > keyvault-az-60d.json`
I'll also `describe-key` outputs for metadata. No rotations until artifacts sealed.

anya: For evidence integrity, we need immutable uploads and operator attestations. Tom, can you create a manifest format with filename, sha256, capture-command, operator, timestamp, and signature (GPG/cosign)? Also include the shell session recording IDs.

tom: Yep. Example manifest line: `keyvault-az-60d.json, <sha256>, az monitor activity-log list ..., rachel, 2024-10-03T16:10:00Z, gpg:0xC0FFEE01, cosign:sha256:<digest>, session:tlog:abcd1234`. I'll store README_FOR_VENDOR.txt explaining verification steps.

derek: Rollback CLI: for cloud projects: `gcloud projects set-iam-policy $P pre-iam.$TS.json` and for Azure `az role assignment delete --assignee svc-plat-canary --role infra.restrict` if needed; terraform rollback via `rollback-state` branch. I'll snapshot terraform state and upload to secure artifact store before changes.

ops-oncall: I'll put an oncall alert policy in place for `PERMISSION_DENIED` spikes and `SetIamPolicy` events. If denied rate > baseline+5% for 10m, we rollback and page SRE. Also I'll keep pager escalation list in the runbook.

rachel: Packaging steps: export slices -> compute sha256 -> create detached GPG signature -> cosign sign the tarball (cosign key in sigstore) -> upload to bucket with versioning -> set retention. Example commands: `tar -czf kms-60d.tar.gz *.ndjson && sha256sum kms-60d.tar.gz > kms-60d.tar.gz.sha256 && gpg --detach-sign --local-user 0xC0FFEE01 kms-60d.tar.gz && cosign sign --key cosign.key kms-60d.tar.gz`

tom: For vendor access I'll produce presigned URLs valid 7 days and include vendor PGP fingerprint in README so they can verify signatures. Vendor asked for operator accountability info (which shell session, who ran commands). We'll store tlog IDs and hashed shell histories.

vendor-bot: VectorSec: Please supply PGP fingerprint or cosign public key to accept signed evidence. Also confirm retest window preference after upload.

anya: Final owner checklist for Thu window:
- derek: RBAC PR + pre/post snapshots + rollback-state (owner: derek)
- rachel: KMS/audit exports + key metadata (owner: rachel)
- tom: evidence bucket + bundle + signatures + presigned links (owner: tom)
- ops-oncall: alerting + rollback + pager (owner: ops-oncall)
- anya: vendor coordination + retest booking (owner: anya)

anya: React with :thumbsup: if you accept owners and will be present. If someone can't attend, flag now and we'll reschedule the window.

derek: :thumbsup: I'll post PR tonight.

rachel: :thumbsup: starting key inventory now.

tom: :thumbsup: will provision bucket and pre-create upload script.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: pager is ready.

vendor-bot: VectorSec: acknowledged. Waiting for PGP/cosign key.

anya: Thanks all. I'll lock calendar and keep this thread as the single-source-of-truth for the artifact manifest link and live notes during the window.
